# Auto Ontology model-import document for schema `code` (POST /api/model/import, replace=false).
# source: code_registry   id namespace: cob:auto_ontology_code:
# repo_url: https://github.com/NVIDIA/auto-ontology
# commit_sha: cdaf61e1bd0cf3820d11d72b43bb460816aebbd3
# source_fingerprint: 158fe223627725d6
# snapshot_id: cdaf61e1bd0c-158fe2236277
# builder_version: code-ontology-bridge 0.1.0   built_at: 2026-11-03T08:41:39Z
# known_limits:
#   - Only Python files are analysed; other languages in the repository are not represented.
#   - Dynamic imports (importlib, __import__) and imports executed through strings are not resolved.
#   - Internal callees are resolved only through plain dotted names: same-file definitions, import bindings (following re-exports up to 3 levels), and self/cls methods of the enclosing class. Every other call keeps a null callee and is classified, never guessed: builtin (an unshadowed builtin name), external (rooted in a non-internal import or a module-level name assigned from one), dynamic_attribute (a method on an object whose type this analysis does not infer), or unresolved (parameters, local callables, super() and anything left).
#   - Functions passed by reference are recorded as call_kind callback (low confidence) only when a plain dotted name appears directly as a positional or keyword argument of a call inside a function and resolves, by the same rules, to an internal function or method: asyncio.to_thread(f, x), loop.run_in_executor(None, f), executor.submit(f), Thread(target=f), functools.partial(f), Depends(f). References held in lists, dicts, assignments, return values or decorators without a call are not recorded, a name the enclosing function binds locally is skipped, properties passed as values are skipped, arguments of inspect.* and of builtins that only examine a value (getattr, isinstance, print, repr and the like) are skipped, and every other receiving call is assumed, not proven, to invoke the reference.
#   - Builtin classification does not see local variables or parameters that shadow a builtin name.
#   - Inherited methods resolve only when the base class is statically resolvable to a definition in the repository; such calls are marked low confidence.
#   - Imports inside a function bind only there. Other local variables that shadow a module-level name are not tracked, so such a call may resolve to the module-level definition.
#   - Nested functions and classes are not symbols. A nested function's calls count for the enclosing symbol only when it calls that function or passes it on by name.
#   - Test links are static: a test that exercises a file without importing it, and without a matching file name, is not linked.
#   - Descriptions and summaries are verbatim docstring text; no description is generated or inferred.
#   - Calls at module level, outside any function or class, are not recorded (1046 in this snapshot).
#   - Calls in nested functions the enclosing function never runs (registered handlers, returned closures) are not recorded (229 in this snapshot).
#   - 3 module names are shared by several files (e.g. top-level test modules); imports of those names are not resolved.
# Certified flags are not part of this document; they are set by PATCH from certification events.

  databases:
  - id: cob:auto_ontology_code:database
    dialect: duckdb
    schemas:
    - id: cob:auto_ontology_code:schema:code

          description: Position of the heading within the file's docstring, from 1.
          type: INTEGER
          sample_values: []
          is_nullable: false
          is_unique: false
      - id: cob:auto_ontology_code:table:code.symbols
        name: symbols
        description: Functions, methods and classes, their definition locations and extracted docstring
          summaries. Use this table for function definitions and function docstring questions.
        pk:
        - cob:auto_ontology_code:column:code.symbols.symbol_id
        type: BASE TABLE
        columns:
        - id: cob:auto_ontology_code:column:code.symbols.symbol_id
          name: symbol_id
          description: 'ID: file path, ''::'', qualified name; repeated qualified definitions append @L<definition-line>.'
          type: VARCHAR
          sample_values: []
          is_nullable: false
          is_unique: true
        - id: cob:auto_ontology_code:column:code.symbols.file_id
          name: file_id
          description: File that defines the symbol.
          type: VARCHAR
          sample_values: []
          is_nullable: false
          is_unique: false
        - id: cob:auto_ontology_code:column:code.symbols.name
          name: name
          description: Bare name of the symbol.
          type: VARCHAR
          sample_values: []
          is_nullable: false
          is_unique: false
        - id: cob:auto_ontology_code:column:code.symbols.qualname
          name: qualname
          description: Dotted name within the module, e.g. Class.method.
          type: VARCHAR
          sample_values: []
          is_nullable: false
          is_unique: false
        - id: cob:auto_ontology_code:column:code.symbols.kind
          name: kind
          description: function, method or class.
          type: VARCHAR
          sample_values:
          - class
          - function
          - method
          is_nullable: false
          is_unique: false
        - id: cob:auto_ontology_code:column:code.symbols.line_start
          name: line_start
          description: First line of the definition, decorators excluded.
          type: INTEGER
          sample_values: []
          is_nullable: false
          is_unique: false
        - id: cob:auto_ontology_code:column:code.symbols.line_end
          name: line_end
          description: Last line of the definition.
          type: INTEGER
          sample_values: []
          is_nullable: false
          is_unique: false
        - id: cob:auto_ontology_code:column:code.symbols.is_public
          name: is_public
          description: True when neither the name nor any enclosing class name starts with an underscore.
          type: BOOLEAN

          is_nullable: false
          is_unique: false
        - id: cob:auto_ontology_code:column:code.symbols.summary
          name: summary
          description: First paragraph (or Teleology atom) of this function, method or class docstring,
            with whitespace normalized; empty when absent. This is the function documentation, unlike
            optional module headings.
          type: VARCHAR
          sample_values: []
          is_nullable: false
          is_unique: false
        - id: cob:auto_ontology_code:column:code.symbols.summary_source
          name: summary_source
          description: docstring or none.
          type: VARCHAR
          sample_values:
          - docstring
          - none
          is_nullable: false
          is_unique: false

        type: BASE TABLE
        columns:
        - id: cob:auto_ontology_code:column:code.class_bases.class_symbol_id
          name: class_symbol_id
          description: Class whose statement names the base.
          type: VARCHAR
          sample_values: []
          is_nullable: false
          is_unique: false
        - id: cob:auto_ontology_code:column:code.class_bases.ordinal
          name: ordinal
          description: Position of the base in the class statement, from 1.
          type: INTEGER
          sample_values: []
          is_nullable: false
          is_unique: false
        - id: cob:auto_ontology_code:column:code.class_bases.base_name
          name: base_name

      - id: cob:auto_ontology_code:table:code.calls
        name: calls
        description: Call edges inside functions, methods and class bodies, with how the callee was resolved.

          classified as builtin, external, dynamic_attribute or unresolved. Callback rows record an internal

          x).
        pk:

        columns:
        - id: cob:auto_ontology_code:column:code.calls.call_id

          description: 'Stable id: file path, line, column and a sequence number (for a callback row,
            the position of the argument).'
          type: VARCHAR
          sample_values: []
          is_nullable: false
          is_unique: true
        - id: cob:auto_ontology_code:column:code.calls.caller_symbol_id
          name: caller_symbol_id
          description: Symbol whose body contains the call.
          type: VARCHAR
          sample_values: []
          is_nullable: false
          is_unique: false
        - id: cob:auto_ontology_code:column:code.calls.callee_symbol_id
          name: callee_symbol_id

          type: VARCHAR
          sample_values: []
          is_nullable: true
          is_unique: false
        - id: cob:auto_ontology_code:column:code.calls.callee_name
          name: callee_name
          description: Callee as written at the call site, e.g. self.save or pd.read_csv; for a callback
            row, the reference as written in the argument.
          type: VARCHAR
          sample_values: []
          is_nullable: false
          is_unique: false
        - id: cob:auto_ontology_code:column:code.calls.line
          name: line
          description: Line of the call.
          type: INTEGER
          sample_values: []
          is_nullable: false
          is_unique: false
        - id: cob:auto_ontology_code:column:code.calls.resolution
          name: resolution
          description: same_file, imported or method_on_self (internal callee found); builtin (a Python
            builtin such as len); external (rooted in a third-party or standard-library import, or a module-level
            name assigned from one, e.g. logger); dynamic_attribute (a method on an object whose type
            is not statically known, e.g. row.get); unresolved (anything else).
          type: VARCHAR
          sample_values:
          - builtin
          - dynamic_attribute
          - external
          - imported
          - method_on_self
          - same_file
          - unresolved
          is_nullable: false
          is_unique: false
        - id: cob:auto_ontology_code:column:code.calls.confidence
          name: confidence
          description: 'high or low: low for inherited methods, callback rows, dynamic_attribute and unresolved.'

          sample_values:

          - low
          is_nullable: false
          is_unique: false
        - id: cob:auto_ontology_code:column:code.calls.call_kind
          name: call_kind
          description: direct (the call site invokes the callee) or callback (an internal function or

            confidence.
          type: VARCHAR
          sample_values:
          - callback
          - direct
          is_nullable: false
          is_unique: false
      - id: cob:auto_ontology_code:table:code.imports
        name: imports

        - id: cob:auto_ontology_code:column:code.imports.import_id

        - id: cob:auto_ontology_code:column:code.imports.imported_file_id
          name: imported_file_id
          description: Internal file the import resolves to; null for external or unresolvable imports.
          type: VARCHAR
          sample_values: []
          is_nullable: true
          is_unique: false
        - id: cob:auto_ontology_code:column:code.imports.module_name
          name: module_name
          description: Absolute dotted module name imported (relative imports resolved).

          sample_values: []
          is_nullable: false
          is_unique: false
        - id: cob:auto_ontology_code:column:code.imports.line
          name: line
          description: Line of the import statement.
          type: INTEGER
          sample_values: []
          is_nullable: false
          is_unique: false
        - id: cob:auto_ontology_code:column:code.imports.is_internal
          name: is_internal
          description: True when the module belongs to the analysed repository.
          type: BOOLEAN
          sample_values: []
          is_nullable: false
          is_unique: false
      - id: cob:auto_ontology_code:table:code.test_links
        name: test_links
        description: Static associations between a test file and a source file, inferred because the test
          imports the file or its name matches. They are not measured test execution or coverage.
        pk:
        - cob:auto_ontology_code:column:code.test_links.test_file_id
        - cob:auto_ontology_code:column:code.test_links.target_file_id
        - cob:auto_ontology_code:column:code.test_links.reason
        type: BASE TABLE
        columns:
        - id: cob:auto_ontology_code:column:code.test_links.test_file_id
          name: test_file_id
          description: Test file.
          type: VARCHAR
          sample_values: []
          is_nullable: false
          is_unique: false
        - id: cob:auto_ontology_code:column:code.test_links.target_file_id
          name: target_file_id
          description: Non-test file the test is linked to.
          type: VARCHAR
          sample_values: []
          is_nullable: false
          is_unique: false
        - id: cob:auto_ontology_code:column:code.test_links.reason
          name: reason
          description: imports_target (the test imports the file) or name_match (test_<name>.py matches
            <name>.py).
          type: VARCHAR
          sample_values:
          - imports_target
          - name_match
          is_nullable: false
          is_unique: false
      - id: cob:auto_ontology_code:table:code.inbound_call_counts
        name: inbound_call_counts
        description: Every symbol with the number of resolved direct call sites that target it, the number
          of callback references to it, and the number of distinct callers of either kind.
        pk: []
        type: VIEW
        columns:
        - id: cob:auto_ontology_code:column:code.inbound_call_counts.symbol_id
          name: symbol_id
          description: 'ID: file path, ''::'', qualified name; repeated qualified definitions append @L<definition-line>.'
          type: VARCHAR
          sample_values: []
          is_nullable: true
          is_unique: false
        - id: cob:auto_ontology_code:column:code.inbound_call_counts.file_id
          name: file_id
          description: File that defines the symbol.
          type: VARCHAR
          sample_values: []
          is_nullable: true
          is_unique: false
        - id: cob:auto_ontology_code:column:code.inbound_call_counts.name
          name: name
          description: Bare name of the symbol.
          type: VARCHAR
          sample_values: []
          is_nullable: true
          is_unique: false
        - id: cob:auto_ontology_code:column:code.inbound_call_counts.qualname
          name: qualname
          description: Dotted name within the module, e.g. Class.method.
          type: VARCHAR
          sample_values: []
          is_nullable: true
          is_unique: false
        - id: cob:auto_ontology_code:column:code.inbound_call_counts.kind
          name: kind
          description: function, method or class.
          type: VARCHAR
          sample_values: []
          is_nullable: true
          is_unique: false
        - id: cob:auto_ontology_code:column:code.inbound_call_counts.is_public
          name: is_public
          description: True when neither the name nor any enclosing class name starts with an underscore.
          type: BOOLEAN
          sample_values: []
          is_nullable: true
          is_unique: false
        - id: cob:auto_ontology_code:column:code.inbound_call_counts.inbound_calls
          name: inbound_calls
          description: Number of resolved direct call sites whose callee is this symbol.
          type: HUGEINT
          sample_values: []
          is_nullable: true
          is_unique: false
        - id: cob:auto_ontology_code:column:code.inbound_call_counts.callback_references
          name: callback_references
          description: Number of places where this symbol is passed by reference as an argument to another
            call.
          type: HUGEINT
          sample_values: []
          is_nullable: true
          is_unique: false
        - id: cob:auto_ontology_code:column:code.inbound_call_counts.distinct_callers
          name: distinct_callers
          description: Number of distinct symbols that call this symbol directly or pass it as a callback.
          type: BIGINT
          sample_values: []

          is_unique: false
      - id: cob:auto_ontology_code:table:code.untested_public_symbols
        name: untested_public_symbols
        description: Public symbols in non-test files whose file has no recorded test association (no

        pk: []
        type: VIEW
        columns:
        - id: cob:auto_ontology_code:column:code.untested_public_symbols.symbol_id
          name: symbol_id
          description: 'ID: file path, ''::'', qualified name; repeated qualified definitions append @L<definition-line>.'
          type: VARCHAR
          sample_values: []
          is_nullable: true
          is_unique: false
        - id: cob:auto_ontology_code:column:code.untested_public_symbols.file_id
          name: file_id

          sample_values: []

semantic_layer:
  terms:
  - id: cob:auto_ontology_code:term:snapshot
    name: Code snapshot
    description: 'One row identifying the analysed source: repository, commit, content fingerprint, builder
      and its known limits.'
    represents:
    - cob:auto_ontology_code:table:code.snapshot
    columns_attributes:
    - id: cob:auto_ontology_code:attribute:code.snapshot.snapshot_id
      name: snapshot id
      description: 'Stable id of this snapshot: commit prefix and fingerprint prefix.'
      column_id: cob:auto_ontology_code:column:code.snapshot.snapshot_id
    - id: cob:auto_ontology_code:attribute:code.snapshot.repo_url
      name: repo url
      description: URL of the analysed repository.
      column_id: cob:auto_ontology_code:column:code.snapshot.repo_url
    - id: cob:auto_ontology_code:attribute:code.snapshot.commit_sha
      name: commit sha
      description: Commit SHA of the analysed checkout.
      column_id: cob:auto_ontology_code:column:code.snapshot.commit_sha
    - id: cob:auto_ontology_code:attribute:code.snapshot.built_at
      name: built at
      description: UTC time the map was built, ISO 8601 (SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH when set).
      column_id: cob:auto_ontology_code:column:code.snapshot.built_at
    - id: cob:auto_ontology_code:attribute:code.snapshot.builder_version
      name: builder version
      description: Name and version of the builder that produced the rows.
      column_id: cob:auto_ontology_code:column:code.snapshot.builder_version
    - id: cob:auto_ontology_code:attribute:code.snapshot.source_fingerprint
      name: source fingerprint
      description: 16-hex SHA-256 digest over sorted 'path NUL file-sha256' lines of every analysed file.
      column_id: cob:auto_ontology_code:column:code.snapshot.source_fingerprint
    - id: cob:auto_ontology_code:attribute:code.snapshot.file_count
      name: file count
      description: Number of Python files analysed.
      column_id: cob:auto_ontology_code:column:code.snapshot.file_count
    - id: cob:auto_ontology_code:attribute:code.snapshot.omitted_file_count
      name: omitted file count
      description: Number of Python files found but not analysed (excluded or unparseable).
      column_id: cob:auto_ontology_code:column:code.snapshot.omitted_file_count
    - id: cob:auto_ontology_code:attribute:code.snapshot.known_limits
      name: known limits
      description: JSON array of plain-language limits of the static analysis.
      column_id: cob:auto_ontology_code:column:code.snapshot.known_limits
  - id: cob:auto_ontology_code:term:files
    name: Source file
    description: One row per analysed Python source file. Module and package descriptions are in files.description;
      a package description belongs to its __init__.py row.
    represents:
    - cob:auto_ontology_code:table:code.files
    columns_attributes:
    - id: cob:auto_ontology_code:attribute:code.files.file_id
      name: file id
      description: Repository-relative path of the file, with forward slashes.
      column_id: cob:auto_ontology_code:column:code.files.file_id
    - id: cob:auto_ontology_code:attribute:code.files.package
      name: package
      description: Dotted name of the package that contains the module; empty for a top-level module.
      column_id: cob:auto_ontology_code:column:code.files.package
    - id: cob:auto_ontology_code:attribute:code.files.module
      name: module
      description: Dotted import name of the module (a package's __init__.py has the package's name).
      column_id: cob:auto_ontology_code:column:code.files.module
    - id: cob:auto_ontology_code:attribute:code.files.is_test
      name: is test
      description: True when the path or file name marks the file as a test (tests/ or test/ directory,
        test_*.py, *_test.py, conftest.py).
      column_id: cob:auto_ontology_code:column:code.files.is_test
    - id: cob:auto_ontology_code:attribute:code.files.line_count
      name: line count
      description: Number of lines in the file.
      column_id: cob:auto_ontology_code:column:code.files.line_count
    - id: cob:auto_ontology_code:attribute:code.files.sha256
      name: sha256
      description: SHA-256 of the file's bytes; used to detect stale certifications.
      column_id: cob:auto_ontology_code:column:code.files.sha256
    - id: cob:auto_ontology_code:attribute:code.files.description
      name: description
      description: Verbatim description from the module docstring; empty when the file has none.
      column_id: cob:auto_ontology_code:column:code.files.description
    - id: cob:auto_ontology_code:attribute:code.files.description_source
      name: description source
      description: 'Where the description came from: heading_purpose, module_docstring or none.'
      column_id: cob:auto_ontology_code:column:code.files.description_source
    - id: cob:auto_ontology_code:attribute:code.files.has_fixed_headings
      name: has fixed headings
      description: True when the module docstring uses the fixed headings [PURPOSE], [INTERFACE], [FLOW],
        [DEPENDENCIES] or [CONSTRAINTS].
      column_id: cob:auto_ontology_code:column:code.files.has_fixed_headings
  - id: cob:auto_ontology_code:term:headings
    name: Docstring heading
    description: Optional fixed sections and contract atoms from module docstrings only. This table can
      be empty even when ordinary module and function docstrings exist. Function docstrings are in symbols.summary,
      not this table.
    represents:
    - cob:auto_ontology_code:table:code.headings
    columns_attributes:
    - id: cob:auto_ontology_code:attribute:code.headings.heading
      name: heading
      description: Heading name such as [PURPOSE], or an atom name such as Teleology or Fails.
      column_id: cob:auto_ontology_code:column:code.headings.heading
    - id: cob:auto_ontology_code:attribute:code.headings.value
      name: value
      description: Verbatim text under the heading or after the atom.
      column_id: cob:auto_ontology_code:column:code.headings.value
    - id: cob:auto_ontology_code:attribute:code.headings.ordinal
      name: ordinal
      description: Position of the heading within the file's docstring, from 1.
      column_id: cob:auto_ontology_code:column:code.headings.ordinal
  - id: cob:auto_ontology_code:term:symbols
    name: Code symbol
    description: Functions, methods and classes, their definition locations and extracted docstring summaries.
      Use this table for function definitions and function docstring questions.
    represents:
    - cob:auto_ontology_code:table:code.symbols
    columns_attributes:
    - id: cob:auto_ontology_code:attribute:code.symbols.symbol_id
      name: symbol id
      description: 'ID: file path, ''::'', qualified name; repeated qualified definitions append @L<definition-line>.'
      column_id: cob:auto_ontology_code:column:code.symbols.symbol_id
    - id: cob:auto_ontology_code:attribute:code.symbols.name
      name: name
      description: Bare name of the symbol.
      column_id: cob:auto_ontology_code:column:code.symbols.name
    - id: cob:auto_ontology_code:attribute:code.symbols.qualname
      name: qualname
      description: Dotted name within the module, e.g. Class.method.
      column_id: cob:auto_ontology_code:column:code.symbols.qualname
    - id: cob:auto_ontology_code:attribute:code.symbols.kind
      name: kind
      description: function, method or class.
      column_id: cob:auto_ontology_code:column:code.symbols.kind
    - id: cob:auto_ontology_code:attribute:code.symbols.line_start
      name: line start
      description: First line of the definition, decorators excluded.
      column_id: cob:auto_ontology_code:column:code.symbols.line_start
    - id: cob:auto_ontology_code:attribute:code.symbols.line_end
      name: line end
      description: Last line of the definition.
      column_id: cob:auto_ontology_code:column:code.symbols.line_end
    - id: cob:auto_ontology_code:attribute:code.symbols.is_public
      name: is public
      description: True when neither the name nor any enclosing class name starts with an underscore.
      column_id: cob:auto_ontology_code:column:code.symbols.is_public
    - id: cob:auto_ontology_code:attribute:code.symbols.summary
      name: summary
      description: First paragraph (or Teleology atom) of this function, method or class docstring, with
        whitespace normalized; empty when absent. This is the function documentation, unlike optional
        module headings.
      column_id: cob:auto_ontology_code:column:code.symbols.summary
    - id: cob:auto_ontology_code:attribute:code.symbols.summary_source
      name: summary source
      description: docstring or none.
      column_id: cob:auto_ontology_code:column:code.symbols.summary_source
  - id: cob:auto_ontology_code:term:class_bases
    name: Class base
    description: Base classes named in each class statement, in order, with the internal class each one
      resolves to.
    represents:
    - cob:auto_ontology_code:table:code.class_bases
    columns_attributes:
    - id: cob:auto_ontology_code:attribute:code.class_bases.ordinal
      name: ordinal
      description: Position of the base in the class statement, from 1.
      column_id: cob:auto_ontology_code:column:code.class_bases.ordinal
    - id: cob:auto_ontology_code:attribute:code.class_bases.base_name
      name: base name
      description: Base expression as written, e.g. SQLDatabase, base.SQLDatabase or Generic[T].
      column_id: cob:auto_ontology_code:column:code.class_bases.base_name
  - id: cob:auto_ontology_code:term:calls
    name: Call site
    description: Call edges inside functions, methods and class bodies, with how the callee was resolved.
      Direct call sites are all kept; those without an internal callee have a null callee and are classified
      as builtin, external, dynamic_attribute or unresolved. Callback rows record an internal function
      or method passed by reference as an argument to another call, e.g. asyncio.to_thread(f, x).
    represents:
    - cob:auto_ontology_code:table:code.calls
    columns_attributes:
    - id: cob:auto_ontology_code:attribute:code.calls.call_id
      name: call id
      description: 'Stable id: file path, line, column and a sequence number (for a callback row, the
        position of the argument).'
      column_id: cob:auto_ontology_code:column:code.calls.call_id
    - id: cob:auto_ontology_code:attribute:code.calls.callee_name
      name: callee name
      description: Callee as written at the call site, e.g. self.save or pd.read_csv; for a callback row,
        the reference as written in the argument.
      column_id: cob:auto_ontology_code:column:code.calls.callee_name
    - id: cob:auto_ontology_code:attribute:code.calls.line
      name: line
      description: Line of the call.
      column_id: cob:auto_ontology_code:column:code.calls.line
    - id: cob:auto_ontology_code:attribute:code.calls.resolution
      name: resolution
      description: same_file, imported or method_on_self (internal callee found); builtin (a Python builtin
        such as len); external (rooted in a third-party or standard-library import, or a module-level
        name assigned from one, e.g. logger); dynamic_attribute (a method on an object whose type is not
        statically known, e.g. row.get); unresolved (anything else).
      column_id: cob:auto_ontology_code:column:code.calls.resolution
    - id: cob:auto_ontology_code:attribute:code.calls.confidence
      name: confidence
      description: 'high or low: low for inherited methods, callback rows, dynamic_attribute and unresolved.'
      column_id: cob:auto_ontology_code:column:code.calls.confidence
    - id: cob:auto_ontology_code:attribute:code.calls.call_kind
      name: call kind
      description: direct (the call site invokes the callee) or callback (an internal function or method
        passed as an argument, e.g. asyncio.to_thread(f, x), executor.submit(f) or Thread(target=f), which
        the receiving call is expected to invoke). Callback rows always carry a callee and low confidence.
      column_id: cob:auto_ontology_code:column:code.calls.call_kind
  - id: cob:auto_ontology_code:term:imports
    name: Import statement
    description: Import statements, one row per imported name, with the internal file each resolves to.
    represents:
    - cob:auto_ontology_code:table:code.imports
    columns_attributes:
    - id: cob:auto_ontology_code:attribute:code.imports.import_id
      name: import id
      description: 'Stable id: file path, line and a sequence number.'
      column_id: cob:auto_ontology_code:column:code.imports.import_id
    - id: cob:auto_ontology_code:attribute:code.imports.module_name
      name: module name
      description: Absolute dotted module name imported (relative imports resolved).
      column_id: cob:auto_ontology_code:column:code.imports.module_name
    - id: cob:auto_ontology_code:attribute:code.imports.line
      name: line
      description: Line of the import statement.
      column_id: cob:auto_ontology_code:column:code.imports.line
    - id: cob:auto_ontology_code:attribute:code.imports.is_internal
      name: is internal
      description: True when the module belongs to the analysed repository.
      column_id: cob:auto_ontology_code:column:code.imports.is_internal
  - id: cob:auto_ontology_code:term:test_links
    name: Test link
    description: Static associations between a test file and a source file, inferred because the test
      imports the file or its name matches. They are not measured test execution or coverage.
    represents:
    - cob:auto_ontology_code:table:code.test_links
    columns_attributes:
    - id: cob:auto_ontology_code:attribute:code.test_links.reason
      name: reason
      description: imports_target (the test imports the file) or name_match (test_<name>.py matches <name>.py).
      column_id: cob:auto_ontology_code:column:code.test_links.reason
